reason: Reviewed the full batch against the approved HH-2 scope. Two repairable issues remain: an undefined coordinate-map application in the fundamental theorem proof, and an unqualified use of an AC-dependent quotient theorem in the comatrix example.

findings.reason: Step 5.1 applies φ_s:A→k to an equality in C⊗(C⊗C), so the map is undefined there. Pull the equality back to A⊗(C⊗C) using the already-declared AC tensor-injection supplier, then apply φ_s; this avoids extending coordinates to C. The cited UCSD proof instead begins with a basis of C (Theorem 1.28, pp. 19–20) [UCSD notes](https://mathweb.ucsd.edu/~drogalsk/207a-s20-lecturenotes.pdf).

Facts F3 and Step 2.1 use thm-hh-coalgebra-quotient-and-kernel-descent, whose statement assumes AC, while this example assumes only a field. Preserve the field-only scope by explicitly defining the quotient maps on its basis u with Δ̄(u)=u⊗u and ε̄(u)=1, then checking the projection on the four comatrix basis vectors.

consumer_checks.reason: Its use of the AC-dependent quotient supplier is not covered by its stated assumptions; the concrete quotient admits a direct local construction.
